Death's Master.name: Death's Master
Death's Master.description:
Abstruse rituals within your spellbook allow you mastery over undeath. While holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

Bolster Undead. As a Bonus Action, choose any number of Undead you have created or summoned with a Necromancy spell that are within 60 feet of you. Those Undead each gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Wizard level. Once you use this Bonus Action, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

Extinguish Undead. When an Undead creature you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can cause it to explode with necrotic energy. Roll a number of d6s equal to half the creature’s unexpended Hit Dice (round up, minimum of 1d6), and add them together. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the Undead makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes Necrotic damage equal to the number rolled and can’t take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. When you use this feature to explode an Undead creature you don’t control, you must take a Reaction and expend a level 5+ spell slot to do so.

Foundry Notes

Extinguish Undead. Place the 10-foot Emanation at the Undead that was reduced to 0 Hit Points. Open that Undead's actor sheet and click the Short Rest icon to see how many Hit Dice it has remaining. Enter that number as the Scaling value.

If you don't control that Undead, also use Expend Reaction/Slot to expend your Reaction and a level 5+ spell slot. Creatures that fail the saving throw can't take Reactions until the start of their next turn; enforce this restriction manually.

Transmuter's Stone.name: Transmuter's Stone
Transmuter's Stone.description:
When you finish a Long Rest, you can create a magic stone that lasts until you use this feature again. The stone is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells. A creature with the stone in its possession gains proficiency in Constitution saving throws and one of the following benefits, which you choose when you create the stone. You can change the stone’s benefit when you cast a Transmutation spell using a spell slot.

Darkvision. The bearer gains Darkvision with a range of 60 feet or increases the range of its Darkvision by 60 feet.

Resistance. The bearer gains Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage (your choice each time you choose this benefit).

Speed. The bearer’s Speed increases by 10 feet.

Foundry Note

This feature includes enchantments that can be applied to your Transmuter Stone. You can remove the enchantments and replace them with new ones as needed. The Resistance enchantment can be used multiple times to apply multiple different resistances.

Dispelling Recovery.name: 驅法復原
Dispelling Recovery.description:
緊接在你使用法術位施放一道恢復生物生命值或終止生物身上狀態的法術後，作為該動作、附贈動作或反應的一部分，你可以無需消耗法術位施放@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{解除魔法}。

一旦使用此特性，直到完成短休或長休前，你無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一次引導神力次數（無需動作）來恢復其使用次數。

Semblance of Life.name: 擬態生命
Semblance of Life.description:
你的契靈夥伴的力量不斷成長，愈發強大。借助你的力量，其能夠短暫化作更加強大的形態。根據契靈的類型，當契靈位於你90呎內時，你可以採取魔法動作使其變形，持續1小時，變為下列形態之一：天界靈魄（天界生物契靈；見《玩家手冊》中的法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonCele]{天界生物召喚術}）、邪魔靈魄（邪魔契靈；見《玩家手冊》中的法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonFien]{邪魔召喚術}），或不死靈魄（不死生物契靈；見《玩家手冊》中的法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonUnde]{不死生物召喚術}）。該契靈的遊戲數據會被靈魄的數值面板所替換，並且該法術的環階等同於你契術師等級的一半（向下取整；最高9環），但該契靈保留其自身的人格、神聖之力附贈動作、生命值以及生命骰。

契靈夥伴獲得等同於該靈魄形態生命值的臨時生命值。若這些臨時生命值在1小時後仍有剩餘，便會消失；並且若該契靈的臨時生命值耗盡，此變形將提前結束。

此特性一經使用，直到完成長休前你無法再次使用。

Foundry 註記

請使用想讓你的契靈夥伴變形成的生物所對應的召喚行動，使其依你的等級縮放，然後將該角色拖放到你的契靈的角色卡上，以進行變形。

Transmuter.description:
Transform Energy and Matter

You study spells that modify energy and matter—to you, the world is eminently mutable. Using your magic, you become a smith at reality’s forge.

Some Transmuters are tinkerers and pranksters. Others seek the power to make and destroy worlds.
Transmuter.name: Transmuter

Alter Memories.name: Alter Memories
Alter Memories.description:
You can make a creature unaware of your magical influence. When you cast an Enchantment spell that imposes the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition using a spell slot, you can choose one creature targeted by the spell. That creature remains unaware of being Charmed by you.

In addition, once before the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to force the chosen creature to make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, you can make the creature lose a number of hours of its memories equal to 1 plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 hour lost; maximum of: [[max(1 + @abilities.int.mod, 1)]] hours). You can make the creature forget less time, and the amount of time can’t exceed the duration of your Enchantment spell.

Benign Transposition.description:
As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Alternatively, you can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Medium or smaller creature. If that creature is willing, you both teleport, swapping places.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Foundry Notes

The Teleport activity handles normal teleport movement but doesn't enforce the swap restrictions. For a swap, verify the other creature is willing and Medium or smaller, then exchange the two tokens' spaces manually.
Benign Transposition.name: Benign Transposition

Curving Shot.name: 曲線射擊
Curving Shot.description: 你習得如何將偏離的彈藥引向新的目標。若你使用具有彈藥屬性的武器進行遠程攻擊檢定時失手，則你可以作為附贈動作，緊接在攻擊失手後使該次射擊偏折向一名新的目標。這個新目標必須位於武器射程內，且位於該次攻擊原目標60呎內的一名你所能看見的生物。對新目標進行一次攻擊檢定。

Focused Strike.name: 凝神擊
Focused Strike.description: 當你使用震懾拳時，無論目標豁免檢定成功與否，目標在對抗你法術的豁免檢定上具有劣勢，直到你的下個回合開始。

Grave Power.name: Grave Power
Grave Power.description:
You have discovered more necromantic insights and inscribed them in your spellbook. While holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

Grave Resilience. When you use Arcane Recovery, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

Overwhelming Necrosis. Damage from your Wizard spells and Wizard features ignores Resistance to Necrotic damage.

Foundry Notes

Overwhelming Necrosis. Foundry doesn't automatically ignore Necrotic Resistance for damage from your Wizard spells and Wizard features. If a target has Resistance to Necrotic damage, apply the full Necrotic damage instead of halving it.

Vestige Spells (War).name: 契靈法術（戰爭）
Vestige Spells (War).description:
契靈夥伴的魔法確保你始終準備著特定的法術。從下列牧師領域中選擇其一：生命、光明、詭術或戰爭。你所選領域的領域法術對你而言視為契術師法術。當你到達的契術師等級等同於你所選領域的領域法術表中所列的牧師等級時，你此後始終準備著所列的法術。

例如，若你為此特性選擇了戰爭領域，當你到達契術師3級時，你便準備了法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{光導箭}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicWeapo]{魔化武器}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShieldofFa]{虔誠護盾}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpiritualW]{靈體武器}。

Undead Thralls.name: Undead Thralls
Undead Thralls.description:
You always have @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimateDea]{Animate Dead} prepared and can cast it without expending a spell slot, but you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. Whenever you start casting the spell, you can increase the spell’s effective level by 1.

In addition, while holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

Undead Fortitude. Whenever you cast a Necromancy spell that creates or summons an Undead, the Undead’s Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points increase by a number equal to your Intelligence modifier plus half your Wizard level (round down).

Withering Strike. Whenever an Undead you control within 60 feet of you hits a creature with an attack roll, the Undead deals extra Necrotic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 Necrotic damage).

Foundry Note

The improvements to Animate Dead are automatically applied. You can use the Spell Improvements enchantment on any other Necromancy spells to integrate the benefits of Undead Fortitude and Withering Strike.

Enchanter.description:
Entrance and Beguile Others

An Enchanter’s magic clouds or captivates minds. Some Enchanters use their abilities to encourage peace and soften cruelty, while others use their mind-altering magic for selfish ends.

In addition, when you make an ability check with the chosen skill, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

Master Transmuter.description:
While you carry your Transmuter’s Stone, you can take a Magic action to consume the reserve of transmutation magic stored inside and choose one of the following benefits. After you use the stone in this way, it crumbles to dust. You can prevent the stone from crumbling by expending a level 7+ spell slot as part of the Magic action you take using this feature.

Major Transformation. You can transmute one nonmagical object—no larger than a 10-foot Cube or eight connected 5-foot Cubes—into another non-magical object of similar size and mass and of equal or lesser value. You must spend 10 minutes handling the object to transform it.

Panacea. You touch a creature as part of this Magic action, and the target regains a number of Hit Points equal to half its Hit Point maximum (round down). The target is cured of all magical contagions, and any curses affecting the target are lifted, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed item. If the target has the Poisoned or Petrified condition, those conditions end.

Restore Life. You cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplRaiseDead0]{Raise Dead} spell without expending a spell slot, using the stone in place of the required Material components.

Restore Youth. You touch one willing creature as part of this Magic action, and the target’s Exhaustion level, if any, decreases to 0, and it permanently appears [[/r 3d10]] years younger, to a minimum of young adulthood.

Foundry Notes

After using Master Transmuter, unequip the Transmuter Stone to represent it crumbling unless you also use Expend Spell Slot to expend a level 7+ spell slot. Re-equip the stone after your next Long Rest when you create it again.

For Panacea, enter half the target's Hit Point maximum, rounded down, as the Scaling value and resolve its other removals manually.

Resolve Major Transformation and Restore Youth manually.
Master Transmuter.name: Master Transmuter

Vestige Companion.name: 契靈夥伴
Vestige Companion.description:
契靈顯化成形，從你的契約中汲取力量。其使用契靈夥伴數值面板，生物類型為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunCelestialVest]{天界生物}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunFiendishVesti]{邪魔}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.aunUndeadVestige]{不死生物}（當你獲得此特性時選擇）。由你決定契靈的外觀，但無論其形態如何，契靈都帶有彰顯其超自然起源的特徵。例如，你可以設定你的契靈是一顆銘刻著符印的特大型浮游顱骨、一圈發光的符文，或是一個不斷變幻的抽象形體。契靈對你和你的盟友態度友善，並服從你的命令。若你死亡，其也會隨之消失。

【戰鬥中的契靈】在戰鬥中，契靈在你的回合內行動。其可以自主移動並使用其反應，但除非你採取附贈動作指揮其採取其數值面板中的動作或其他動作，否則其只會採取迴避動作。當你採取攻擊動作時，你也可以放棄其中一次攻擊，轉而指揮契靈採取契靈打擊動作。若你陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，契靈將自行行動，且不再受限於僅能採取迴避動作。

【契靈的消逝】當契靈的生命值降至0時，其會消失。你可以花費1分鐘進行某種魔法儀式再次顯化契靈，其會以生命值全滿的狀態重新出現在你5呎內的一處未佔據空間。你能以魔法動作將契靈暫時遣散至一處口袋維度。在其被暫時遣散期間，你能以魔法動作讓契靈重新出現在你30呎內的一處未佔據空間。無論契靈是因生命值降至0，還是因進入口袋維度而消失，其都會將其穿戴或攜帶的任何物品留在其原本所在的空間內。

每當你完成長休時，你可以以新的形態召喚契靈，其出現在你5呎內的一處未佔據空間。由你選擇其外觀，並決定其是天界生物、邪魔還是不死生物。若契靈已通過此特性顯化，其形態將轉變為新的樣子。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-arcana-unleashed.actors.Actor.audVestigeCompan caption=false cite=true statblock]

Vestige Power.name: 契靈神威
Vestige Power.description:
現在，每當你完成一次短休或長休，或使用你的祕法回流特性時，你的契靈夥伴都會重獲其神聖之力的使用次數。此外，當你位於契靈夥伴30呎內時，你獲得與該契靈相同的傷害抗力。

Foundry 註記

在符合條件的休息或使用祕法回流後，請在已顯化契靈的角色卡上，手動將其神聖之力重置為1次使用。契術師所獲得的對應傷害抗力不會自動套用；請在其生效期間手動裁定該抗力。

Necromancer.name: Necromancer
Necromancer.description:
Command the Powers of Death and Undeath

You explore the forces of life, death, and undeath. As a necromancer, you learn to manipulate the energy that animates all creatures, and you draw increasing power from the forbidden secrets in your spellbook. Though many see Necromancers as menacing or villainous, not all Necromancers are evil.

Split Enchantment.description:
When you use a spell slot to cast an Enchantment spell, such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCharmPerso]{Charm Person}, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot to target an additional creature, you can increase the spell’s effective level by 1.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Foundry Notes

Cast the qualifying Enchantment spell one spell-slot level higher than the slot you want to expend, allowing Foundry to apply the increased target count and consume that higher-level slot.

Then use the matching Split Enchantment activity. It restores the higher-level slot, expends the correct slot one level lower, and spends one use of Split Enchantment.
Split Enchantment.name: Split Enchantment

Splintered Summons.name: Splintered Summons

utility.condition: When you use a spell slot to cast a Conjuration spell that summons a spirit whose stat block is included in the spell description

Splintered Summons.description:
When you use a spell slot to cast a Conjuration spell that summons a spirit whose stat block is included in the spell description, such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplSummonAber]{Summon Aberration}, you can modify the spell to summon two creatures with the spell instead of one. Each creature is of the same kind, uses the stat block and rules denoted by the spell, and manifests in a different unoccupied space of your choice within the spell’s range, but the summoned creatures’ Hit Point maximums and current Hit Points are halved. If you lose Concentration on the spell, both creatures disappear.

Once you use this feature to modify a spell in this way, you must finish a Long Rest before you can do so again. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5+ spell slot (no action required).

Foundry Notes

Cast the eligible summon spell normally and use its Summon chat button twice to place two copies of the same spirit. Then target both creatures and use Splintered Summons to apply the halved Hit Points effect.

Magical Mastery.description: 你習得四道法師法術，分別為6環、7環、8環與9環各一道。此後，你始終準備著這些法術。每當你獲得牧師等級時，你可以將其中一道法術替換為同環階的另一道法師法術。
Magical Mastery.name: 奧術精通

LNsgAWw8x2cVxyWs.hint: 【戲法】你知曉@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{德魯伊伎倆}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrestidigi]{魔法技倆}其中一個戲法。智力是你施放該戲法的施法屬性。

TC6W4Mugmnci3Re3.hint:
你獲得奧秘和自然的技能熟練。若你已熟練於其中一項，則你改為獲得一個你所選擇的1級戰士其他可學技能的熟練（或在熟練於二者時獲得兩個1級戰士其他可學技能的熟練）。

1級戰士可學技能：特技、馴獸、運動、歷史、洞悉、威嚇、察覺、說服、求生

Arcane Archer Lore.name: 魔射學識
Arcane Archer Lore.description:
你學習了魔法理論和自然的隱秘，賦予你下列好處。

【戲法】你知曉@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{德魯伊伎倆}或@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPrestidigi]{魔法技倆}其中一個戲法。智力是你施放該戲法的施法屬性。

【技能】你獲得奧秘和自然的技能熟練。若你已熟練於其中之一，你改為獲得一個你選擇的1級戰士其他可學技能的熟練（或在熟練於二者時獲得兩個1級戰士其他可學技能的熟練）。

Z2ms9KKLMRagWNna.hint: 你準備可供你以此特性施放的1環以上法術的列表。起始時，從術士法術列表中選擇三道1環法術。推薦選擇@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplJump000000]{跳躍術}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{魔法飛彈}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplShield0000]{護盾術}。

KWXlpdXeV6uSKQmi.hint:
你從術士法術列表中選擇並習得兩道戲法。推薦選擇@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBladeWard0]{劍刃防護}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplThundercla]{鳴雷破}。每當你獲得一個武僧等級時，你可以將這些戲法中的一道替換為另一道你從術士法術列表中選擇的戲法。

當你的武僧等級到達10級時，你習得另一道由你選擇的術士戲法。

Spellcasting.description:
你學會了如何施放法術。施放法術的規則見《玩家手冊》。下文詳述如何將這些規則應用於祕術武者。

【戲法】你從術士法術列表中選擇並習得兩道戲法。推薦選擇@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBladeWard0]{劍刃防護}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplThundercla]{鳴雷破}。每當你獲得一個武僧等級時，你可以將這些戲法中的一道替換為另一道你從術士法術列表中選擇的戲法。

當你的武僧等級到達10級時，你習得另一道由你選擇的術士戲法。

【1環以上的準備法術】你準備可供你以此特性施放的1環以上法術的列表。起始時，從術士法術列表中選擇三道1環法術。推薦選擇@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplJump000000]{跳躍術}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{魔法飛彈}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplShield0000]{護盾術}。

你列表中的法術數量會隨著你獲得武僧等級而增加，如祕術武者施法表的準備法術一欄所示。每當該數量增加時，從術士法術列表中選擇額外的法術，直到你列表中的法術數量與表中的數字一致。所選法術的環階必須是你擁有法術位的環階。例如，若你是7級武僧，你的準備法術列表可以包含五道任意組合的1環與2環的術士法術。

【更換準備的法術】每當你獲得一個武僧等級，你可以將列表中的一道法術替換為另一道你擁有對應環階法術位的術士法術。

【施法屬性】感知是你施放術士法術的施法屬性。

【施法法器】你可以使用奧術法器作為你術士法術的施法法器。

【兼職】若你兼職，且擁有來自多個職業的施法特性，將你武僧等級的三分之一（向下取整）計入，以決定你可用的法術位。
Spellcasting.name: 施法

Potent Stone.name: Potent Stone
Potent Stone.description:
Your Transmuter’s Stone is more versatile. When you create your Transmuter’s Stone, you can choose up to two benefits. You can choose each option other than Resistance only once. If you choose Resistance twice, you must choose different damage types. You can change either or both benefits when you cast a Transmutation spell using a spell slot.

In addition, the following are now among your benefit options for Transmuter’s Stone.

Mighty Build. The bearer has Advantage on Strength saving throws. The bearer also counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.

Tremorsense. The bearer gains Tremorsense with a range of 30 feet.

Foundry Note

These options are automatically added to your [[/item Transmuter's Stone]] feature.

Necromancy Spellbook.description:
Your spellbook’s necromantic secrets grant you additional powers. You gain the following benefits.

Necrotic Resistance. You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

Undead Familiar. The @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar} spell appears in your spellbook. When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: Skeleton or Zombie (see appendix B of the Player’s Handbook for the familiar’s stat block). When you choose one of the normal forms, you can choose Undead as its creature type.

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.

Undead Vitality. When you cast a Necromancy spell using a spell slot, you can choose an Undead creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to regain a number of Hit Points equal to the level of the spell slot expended plus your Wizard level.
Necromancy Spellbook.name: Necromancy Spellbook

53nSv1GAo6wXWt5A.hint: When you cast Find Familiar, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: Skeleton or Zombie. When you choose one of the normal forms, you can choose Undead as its creature type.

yUEiTJrLsByaEvWV.hint: The Find Familiar spell appears in your spellbook.

Undead Vitality.name: Undead Vitality
Undead Vitality.condition: When you cast a Necromancy spell using a spell slot

Focused Conjuration.name: Focused Conjuration
Focused Conjuration.description: Taking damage can’t break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

Empowered Transmutation.name: Empowered Transmutation
Empowered Transmutation.description:
When you use a spell slot to cast a Transmutation spell that doesn’t make an attack roll or force a saving throw, such as @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFly0000000]{Fly} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicWeapo]{Magic Weapon}, you can increase the spell’s effective level by 1.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Foundry Note

This feature can be used to track uses but does not automatically scale the level of the spell.

Instinctive Charm.description:
When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attack misses instead, and if there is another creature within range of the attack other than the attacker, the attacker targets that creature with the triggering attack, using the same attack roll. If multiple creatures are within the attack’s range, you choose which one to target.

Once you take this Reaction, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by casting an Enchantment spell with a spell slot.

Restore Use.name: Restore Use
Restore Use.condition: Cast an Enchantment spell with a spell slot

Instinctive Charm.name: Instinctive Charm

Vestige Spells (Life).description:
契靈夥伴的魔法確保你始終準備著特定的法術。從下列牧師領域中選擇其一：生命、光明、詭術或戰爭。你所選領域的領域法術對你而言視為契術師法術。當你到達的契術師等級等同於你所選領域的領域法術表中所列的牧師等級時，你此後始終準備著所列的法術。

例如，若你為此特性選擇了戰爭領域，當你到達契術師3級時，你便準備了法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{光導箭}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicWeapo]{魔化武器}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShieldofFa]{虔誠護盾}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpiritualW]{靈體武器}。
Vestige Spells (Life).name: 契靈法術（生命）

Warrior of the Mystic Arts.name: 祕術武者
Warrior of the Mystic Arts.description:
融匯武藝與祕術

祕術武者通過運用魔法來增強他們的武藝。他們駕馭著自己的超凡內力，來增強他們的魔法與身體能力。

Harvest Undead.description: You have learned more secrets about the nuances of life and death. Immediately after you become &Reference[Bloodied apply=false] but aren’t reduced to 0 Hit Points from taking damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce an Undead creature under your control that you can see to 0 Hit Points. You then immediately regain a number of Hit Points equal to your Wizard level.
Harvest Undead.name: Harvest Undead

szHaTl5r6pDAcGUp.hint: 你獲得奧秘技能的熟練，或從牧師1級可選技能中選擇一項技能的熟練。

cDw256TLQAb1yXZR.hint: 你習得兩道由你選擇的法師戲法。每當你獲得牧師等級時，你可以將其中一道戲法替換為另一道法師戲法。

Student of Arcana.name: 奧秘學者
Student of Arcana.description:
你獲得下列好處。

【魔法知識】你獲得奧秘技能的熟練，或從牧師1級可選技能中選擇一項技能的熟練。

【戲法】你習得兩道你所選擇的法師戲法。每當你獲得牧師等級時，你可以將其中一道戲法替換為另一道法師戲法。

Magical Ammunition.name: 注魔彈藥
Magical Ammunition.description:
你學會了給你的彈藥注入魔法屬性。作為魔法動作，你可以為一枚非魔法彈藥注入下列其中一種魔法屬性，並將其射向你武器射程內一處你所能看見的固體表面。當該彈藥命中表面時，其魔法效應啟動，彈藥在效應持續期間附著在其所命中的表面上；你能以魔法動作取下已附著的彈藥，提前結束效應。當效應結束時，彈藥將被摧毀。

此特性一經使用，直到完成短休或長休前，你無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一次回氣使用次數（無需動作）來重置此特性的使用權。

【暗幕彈】以彈藥為中心15呎發散區域內佈滿魔法陰影，持續1分鐘。發散區域內的非魔法火焰被熄滅，發散區域內的生物在感知（察覺）檢定和被動察覺上具有−5減值。

【解鎖彈】以彈藥為中心15呎發散區域內爆發出一陣魔法能量。彈藥還會發出一聲響亮的敲擊聲，其聲響最遠300呎內都能聽見。發散區域內任何被一把非魔法鎖具鎖住的物體，其鎖具會被解開，被卡死的物體會被鬆開，被閂住的物體會被打開。若此類物體被多種鎖具鎖住，則只有其中一把鎖會被解開。

【蔓生彈】從彈藥處長出一段120呎長的藤蔓，你和其他生物其後可以在藤蔓上攀爬，藤蔓將在10分鐘後枯萎。

Shadow Shot.name: 遮影彈
Shadow Shot.description: 目標陷入&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}狀態直到其下個回合結束。

Shadow Shot.name: 遮影彈
Shadow Shot.description: 你的彈藥以陰影遮蔽敵人的視線。你命中的生物額外承受等同於一枚奧術射擊骰的心靈傷害，且必須成功通過一次感知豁免檢定，否則陷入&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}狀態直到其下個回合結束。

Hypnotic Presence.description:
Your charming words and enchanting gaze can enthrall another creature. As a Magic action, choose one creature that you can see within 10 feet of yourself. If the target can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition for 1 minute or until the target is more than 10 feet away from you, the target can neither see nor hear you, or the target takes damage. While Charmed, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Foundry Notes

Foundry applies the 1-minute duration automatically, but it doesn't end the effect when the target moves more than 10 feet away, can no longer see or hear you, or takes damage. Remove the Hypnotic Presence effect manually when any of those conditions occurs.

Hypnotic Presence.name: Hypnotic Presence
Hypnotic Presence.description: The target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute or until the target is more than 10 feet away from you, the target can neither see nor hear you, or the target takes damage. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0.

Hypnotic Presence.name: Hypnotic Presence

Wondrous Alteration.name: Wondrous Alteration

Wondrous Alteration.description: While under the effects of the Alter Self spell's Natural Weapons option.
Wondrous Alteration.name: Wondrous Alteration

Wondrous Alteration.description:
You always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAlterSelf0]{Alter Self} spell prepared and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

While under the effects of Alter Self, you gain an additional benefit for each of its options.

Aquatic Adaptation. While underwater, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

Change Appearance. You have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.

Natural Weapons. The damage of your new growth increases to 2d6 damage of the type associated with the growth. You also have Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.

Foundry Note

The Aquatic Adaptation activity can be used to expend your Bonus Action. The Change Appearance activity can be used to apply an Active Effect that grants Advantage. The Natural Weapons changes are automatically applied to the spell's activities.

Shape-Shifter.name: Shape-Shifter
Shape-Shifter.description:
You always have the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPolymorph0]{Polymorph} spell prepared and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

In addition, when you target yourself with the spell, you can modify the spell to gain the benefits below. Once you modify the spell using this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

Game Statistics. In addition to retaining the features specified in the spell, you retain your memories and ability to communicate. You also retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; proficiencies; class features; and feats.

Transmute Spells. While shape-shifted, you can cast spells, but only Transmutation spells that don’t have a Material component that has a specified cost or that is consumed by the spell.

7nJeTyS6ojgzbVPS.hint: 契靈夥伴的魔法確保你始終準備著特定的法術。從下列牧師領域中選擇其一：生命、光明、詭術或戰爭。你所選領域的領域法術對你而言視為契術師法術。當你到達的契術師等級等同於你所選領域的領域法術表中所列的牧師等級時，你此後始終準備著所列的法術。

Enfeebling Shot.name: 虛弱彈
Enfeebling Shot.description: 目標陷入&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態直到其下個回合結束。每當以此方式中毒的目標所發動的攻擊檢定命中時，其該次攻擊的總傷害減少等同於你其中一枚奧術射擊骰擲出的數值。

Enfeebling Shot.name: 虛弱彈
Enfeebling Shot.description: 你的彈藥將損耗目標的力量。你命中的生物額外承受等同於兩枚奧術射擊骰的黯蝕傷害。該目標還必須成功通過一次體質豁免檢定，否則陷入&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態直到其下個回合結束。每當以此方式中毒的目標所發動的攻擊檢定命中時，其該次攻擊的總傷害減少等同於你其中一枚奧術射擊骰擲出的數值。

Durable Summons.description: When you cast a Conjuration spell to summon or create a creature using a spell slot, that creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level when it first appears. While it has these Temporary Hit Points, the creature has Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

Indomitable Teleport.description: 你掌握的魔法讓你逃離險境。當你使用你的不屈特性且該次豁免檢定成功時，你可以傳送到至多60呎一處你所能看見的未佔據空間。
Indomitable Teleport.name: 不屈傳送

Piercing Shot.name: 穿梭彈
Piercing Shot.description:
你賦予彈藥乙太能量。當你使用此選項時，你無需為該次攻擊進行攻擊檢定。作為替代，彈藥會向前射出一道源自你、長30呎、寬1呎的直線，隨後彈藥消失。該直線無視掩護，因為彈藥會穿過固體物體。直線內的每名生物各進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，該生物承受如同被命中時的傷害，外加等同於兩枚奧術射擊骰的穿刺傷害。豁免成功時，該生物承受一半的傷害。

Foundry 註記

穿梭彈無法得知是哪把具有彈藥屬性的武器射出了這一擊。請另外擲出該武器命中時的一般傷害，再加上穿梭彈的傷害，並手動套用合計總傷害：豁免失敗時承受全額傷害，豁免成功時承受合計總傷害的一半。

你與此神聖領域的連結令你始終準備特定法術。當你到達奧秘領域法術表中所列的牧師等級時，此後你始終準備表中所列的法術。

In addition, when you make an ability check with the chosen skill, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

Seeking Shot.description:
你的彈藥能夠追蹤目標。當你使用此選項時，你無需為該次攻擊進行攻擊檢定。作為替代，選擇一名你在過去1分鐘內見過的生物。彈藥會向該生物飛去，必要時會繞過拐角，並無視&Reference[Half Cover]{半身掩護}與&Reference[Three-Quarters Cover]{四分之三掩護}。若目標位於你武器的長射程內，其進行一次敏捷豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，目標承受如同被命中時的傷害，加上等同於兩枚奧術射擊骰的力場傷害，且你得知目標當前的位置。豁免成功時，目標僅承受一半的傷害。若目標超出你武器的長射程，彈藥會在飛行至其所能抵達的最遠距離後消失。

Foundry 註記

請確認目標是在過去1分鐘內見過，且位於武器的長射程內。另外擲出該武器命中時的一般傷害，並與追蹤彈傷害合併計算。豁免失敗時承受全額傷害，豁免成功時承受一半傷害。豁免失敗時，揭示目標的位置。若目標超出長射程，彈藥會在抵達目標前消失。
Seeking Shot.name: 追蹤彈

Vestige Patron.name: 契靈宗主
Vestige Patron.description:
掌控垂死神祇的殘餘之力

你的契約汲取自一位垂死神祇的力量，這一存在曾受無數信徒膜拜，如今卻被拋棄、被遺忘。這位被稱之為契靈的垂死神祇，昔日或許仁慈，或許邪惡，亦或是詭異而不可名狀，但如今的祂只被重獲往昔之權柄的渴望所驅使。契靈需要你的協助。為此，祂願與你共享僅存的力量。

Masterful Shots.name: 宗師射術
Masterful Shots.description: 你的射擊過程中你總是保持著機敏。當一名你所能看見的生物對你進行攻擊檢定並失手時，你可以採取反應，向遠離攻擊者的方向移動至多等同於你速度一半的距離，且不會引發藉機攻擊。其後作為該反應的一部分，若攻擊者位於你武器的射程範圍內，你可以對其進行一次遠程攻擊檢定。

Conjuration Savant.name: Conjuration Savant
Conjuration Savant.description:
Choose two Wizard spells from the Conjuration school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Conjuration school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Arcane Shot.description:
你習得如何用射術釋放特殊的魔法效應。

【奧術射擊選項】你從本子職業描述後文的「奧術射擊選項」一節中習得兩種由你選擇的奧術射擊選項。

當你的戰士等級到達7級、10級、15級和18級時，你均可額外習得一種你所選擇的奧術射擊選項。每次你習得新的奧術射擊選項時，你也可以將你已知的一種選項替換為另一種。

【使用奧術射擊】每回合一次，當你使用具有彈藥屬性的武器發動遠程攻擊時，你可以將你的一種奧術射擊選項賦予該次攻擊。除非某選項不涉及到攻擊檢定，否則你在命中一名生物並對其造成傷害時決定是否使用該選項。

你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的智力調整值（至少1次）。當你完成短休或長休時，你重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

【奧術射擊骰】奧術射擊選項依賴你的奧術射擊骰。你的奧術射擊骰為[[lookup @scale.arcane-archer.arcane-shot.die]]{d6}。

【豁免檢定】若某個奧術射擊選項要求進行豁免檢定，其DC為8 + 你的智力調整值 + 你的熟練加值。

【隨級提升】當你到達一定的戰士等級時，你的奧術射擊骰會改變。該骰在10級時變為d8，在15級時變為d10，在18級時變為d12。

fw8yHNCnQkj4nRqD.hint:

Arcane Shot.name: 奧術射擊

Vestige Recovery.name: 契靈復甦
Vestige Recovery.description: 當你的契靈夥伴將要降至0點生命值時，你可以採取反應並消耗一個契約魔法法術位，改為將其生命值變為其生命值上限。隨後，該契靈傳送到位於其30呎內一處你所能看見的未佔據空間。此特性一經使用，直到完成長休前你無法再次使用。

Bursting Shot.name: 爆裂彈
Bursting Shot.description: 你將爆炸性的魔法能量注入彈藥。緊接在你對該生物造成傷害後，你的目標，以及位於以目標為中心10呎發散區域內的每名生物，承受等同於兩枚奧術射擊骰的力場傷害。

Mystic Fighting Style.description:
當你在自己的回合採取攻擊動作時，你可以將一次徒手打擊替換為施放一道你的術士戲法，且該戲法的施法時間須為動作。

Foundry 註記

使用祕法戰鬥風格時，請從你的法術書施放符合條件的戲法，並將該次施放視為取代你攻擊動作中的一次徒手打擊。
Mystic Fighting Style.name: 祕法戰鬥風格

Improved Fighting Style.description:
當你使用疾風連擊時，你可以將其中兩次徒手打擊替換為施放你的一道施法時間為動作的1環或2環術士法術，且該法術的施放視為你啟動疾風連擊的同一個附贈動作的一部分。

Foundry 註記

使用一般的疾風連擊行動，然後從你的法術書施放符合條件的1環或2環法術，以取代其中兩次徒手打擊。不要進行那兩次被替換的打擊。
Improved Fighting Style.name: 精通祕法戰鬥風格

Arcane Archer.description:
以附魔之矢，施魔法之要

魔射手深研獨特的精靈箭術，將魔法融入箭擊，產生超自然效應。幾個世紀以來，其他種族也學會了這一箭技，並將其擴展到更多種類的遠程武器，同時也將箭技應用在戰鬥外的冒險之中。
Arcane Archer.name: 魔射手

Vestige Spells (Trickery).name: 契靈法術（詭術）
Vestige Spells (Trickery).description:
契靈夥伴的魔法確保你始終準備著特定的法術。從下列牧師領域中選擇其一：生命、光明、詭術或戰爭。你所選領域的領域法術對你而言視為契術師法術。當你到達的契術師等級等同於你所選領域的領域法術表中所列的牧師等級時，你此後始終準備著所列的法術。

例如，若你為此特性選擇了戰爭領域，當你到達契術師3級時，你便準備了法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{光導箭}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicWeapo]{魔化武器}、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShieldofFa]{虔誠護盾}與@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpiritualW]{靈體武器}。

Arcana Domain.name: 奧秘領域
Arcana Domain.description:
增幅你的魔法之力

魔法充盈於整個多元宇宙之中，既帶來了毀滅，也帶來了創生。奧秘領域的牧師將魔法知識視作一件需要他們分享的禮物，而非用於攫取私利的工具。

與奧秘領域相關的神明對魔法的祕密與潛力有著深刻的理解。這些神明通常也與知識、祕密或力量有所聯繫。
